import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 11) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        long[][] points = new long[n][5];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                points[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
            }
        }

        HashSet<Integer> bad = new HashSet<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            outer:
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long[] vj = vectorFrom(points, i, j);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {

                    if (!sameVector(vj, vk) && positiveDot(vj, vk)) {
                        bad.add(i + 1);
                        break outer;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(n - bad.size());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad.contains(i)) {
                System.out.println(i);
            }
        }
    }

    private static long[] vectorFrom(long[][] points, int from, int to) {
        return new long[]{
            points[to][0] - points[from][0],
            points[to][1] - points[from][1],
            points[to][2] - points[from][2],
            points[to][3] - points[from][3],
            points[to][4] - points[from][4]
        };
    }

    private static boolean sameVector(long[] a, long[] b) {
        return a[0] == b[0] && a[1] == b[1] && a[2] == b[2] && a[3] == b[3] && a[4] == b[4];
    }

    private static boolean positiveDot(long[] a, long[] b) {
        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            sum += a[i] * b[i];
        }
        return sum > 0;
    }

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {

    static class Vec {
        long a, b, c, d, e;

        Vec(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.c = c;
            this.d = d;
            this.e = e;
        }

        long dot(Vec o) {
            return a * o.a + b * o.b + c * o.c + d * o.d + e * o.e;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof Vec)) return false;
            Vec o = (Vec) obj;
            return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c && d == o.d && e == o.e;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(a, b, c, d, e);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 11) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        long[][] points = new long[n][5];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                points[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
            }
        }

        boolean[] bad = new boolean[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Set<Vec> vectors = new HashSet<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                vectors.add(new Vec(
                    points[j][0] - points[i][0],
                    points[j][1] - points[i][1],
                    points[j][2] - points[i][2],
                    points[j][3] - points[i][3],
                    points[j][4] - points[i][4]
                ));
            }

            List<Vec> unique = new ArrayList<>(vectors);
            boolean found = false;
            for (int a = 0; a < unique.size() && !found; a++) {
                for (int b = a + 1; b < unique.size(); b++) {
                    if (unique.get(a).dot(unique.get(b)) > 0) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            bad[i] = found;
        }

        int good = 0;
        for (boolean b : bad) {
            if (!b) good++;
        }

        System.out.println(good);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!bad[i]) {
                System.out.println(i + 1);
            }
        }
    }
}
